title: Sunshine For The Soul | Stay On 30a – Luxury Beach Homes In 30a Florida
description_expanded: Welcome to 'Sunshine for the Soul,' your family-friendly escape in the heart of Prominence! This beautifully updated 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhome blends modern comfort with coastal charm, making it the perfect setting for unforgettable beach days, poolside lounging, and evenings spent exploring all that 30A has to offer. Step inside to find fresh, thoughtfully curated interiors with décor designed to make you feel instantly at home. The open-concept living space is bright and inviting, featuring a spacious lounge area with Smart TVs in every room, perfect for movie nights after a day in the sun. The fully stocked kitchen is equipped for both quick snacks and elaborate family meals, complete with stainless steel appliances, stone countertops, and seating for the whole group. The location couldn’t be better being directly across from The Big Chill, where you can enjoy live music, outdoor movies, boutique shopping, and a variety of dining options just steps from your door. Getting to the beach is a breeze with your complimentary 6-seater golf cart and bikes. Just a quick ride will have you soaking up the sun and enjoying the sugar-white sand in no time. No need to pack bulky gear we’ve provided beach chairs, an umbrella, and more so you can travel light. If you prefer to stay to home, you’ll love spending the day at the 5,000 sq. ft. resort-style community pool, complete with loungers, shaded areas, and a relaxing atmosphere. Whether you’re here for a quick getaway or a week-long vacation, Sunshine for the Soul is your place to relax, reconnect, and make lasting memories on 30A. TWO STORY UNIT 1st Floor— Garage, Kitchen, Dining Area, Living Room W/Sleeper Sofa, Half Bath, and Laundry Room 2nd Floor— 3 Bedrooms, 2 Full Baths ACCOMMODATIONS: Sunshine for the Soul comfortably accommodates up to 8 people: Bedroom 1: Queen Bedroom 2: King Bedroom 3: King, With Ensuite Living Room: Queen Sleeper Sofa FEATURES: 6 Adult Bikes 6 Seater Golf Cart Large Private Patio Fully Stocked Kitchen Drip/Keurig Coffee Maker Full Washer/Dryer Smart TVs Beach Gear Walking Distance to The Big Chill **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | Pool Towels WELCOME BUNDLE: Coffee Grounds | Coffee Filters | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water PARKING Two driveway parking spaces available. The garage is reserved for the golf cart. For parking additional vehicles, the HOA requires vehicles be parked in the gravel street spaces on the South side of the community. Included is a 6 seater golf cart and 6 bicycles for your convenience. To drive golf cart, you must be: 25 years old, sign a liability waiver, and have valid insurance and driver's license. Golf Cart is included as an amenity, at no additional cost. WALKABLE NEIGHBORHOOD AMENITIES -2 Community Pools (heated seasonally October/November & March/April) -Beautiful cabana area with grills -Restaurants, Bars, Ice Cream & Coffee Shops -Shopping -Amphitheater for Live Music, Movies & More -30-A Bicycle Trail PROMINENCE AMENITIES Prominence on 30A is centrally located and has a variety of on-site and by amenities that make this community one of the most highly sought-after vacation destinations in 30A. This community features incredible amenities such as: 2 community pools and a beautiful cabana area for grilling. *Heated Pool during the months of October, November, March and April* NEARBY BEACH ACCESS -Deer Lake State Park (0.6 miles west of Prominence) is the nearest beach access. This park has great amenities including: restrooms, parking for golf carts/bikes/cars, and a beautiful walk along a boardwalk that winds through the natural dunes leading to the beach. The State Park charges a “Day Use Fee” of $3/car or $2/bikes or pedestrians for access and parking. Alcohol is not allowed as it is a State Park. It is a bit of a longer walk from parking area to the beach, but it’s a beautiful scenic walk on the long boardwalk with white sand dunes. The State Park Beach is less crowded than any public beach access points. – Walton Dunes Beach Access (1.5 miles West of Prominence) has a small parking lot, but no bathrooms, and is located just west of the Deer Lake State Park boundary. This access has no steps-just walk straight onto the beach. One of our personal favorites! -Gulf Lakes Estates is a South Walton County beach access (1 mile east of Prominence). Small access that can be easily missed. Parking not available but easy bike ride to the beach. -Santa Clara is a public beach access located at Bramble Grove Place (about 3.5 miles). This access provides a lifeguard, parking and bathrooms as well as ADA access to the beach. THE BIG CHILL (FORMERLY "THE HUB") The community’s town center, called “The Big Chill,” includes restaurants, shops, and an amphitheater. The amphitheater includes a covered event pavilion and is a great place to catch a concert, sporting event, or a movie on the lawn. This location is perfect for family outings! Be sure to catch the farmer's market here on Thursdays! HOTSPOTS NEARBY The location of Prominence is perfectly placed right in the middle of 30a. Popular spots are a short drive away: Seaside, Watercolor, & Seagrove Beach to the west; Alys Beach, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beach to the east. Seaside is a short drive away and is most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater and neighborhood school. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises. *No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including porch *No parties or events. *Complimentary golf cart can only be operated by guests over 25 years of age who provide verification. Rental agreement requires a valid drivers license and proof of existing auto insurance coverage. *During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi. *Space must remain pet free! *There are no refunds for weather related events. We advise trip insurance during hurricane season (May-November) IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver’s license and 2) a "selfie". Other things to note
